app.title: Layout
toolbar.openHint: Open a plan (.json), or a drawing to trace (image or PDF). You can also drop a file onto the page.
hint.orbit: Drag to turn · right-drag to pan · scroll to zoom · double-click a floor to walk there
hint.walk: Drag to look · W A S D or arrows to move · Shift to hurry · Esc to leave
load.invalid: This plan has errors and cannot be built.
issue.notPlan: This is not a Layout plan file.
issue.missingList: The level is missing its {list} list.
issue.duplicateId: The id "{id}" is used more than once.
issue.unknownNode: Wall {id} refers to a point that does not exist.
issue.unknownWall: Opening {id} is on a wall that does not exist.
issue.duplicateWall: Wall {id} doubles another wall between the same points.
issue.nodesOverlap: Points {a} and {b} are on top of each other.
issue.wallsCross: Walls {a} and {b} cross without a shared point.
issue.openingOutside: Opening {id} sticks out past the end of its wall.
issue.openingHeight: Opening {id} has its sill at or above its head.
issue.orphanTag: Room name "{name}" is not inside any closed room.
toolbar.saveHint: Download the plan as a .json file
confirm.replace: Replace the current plan? Changes you have not saved as a file will be lost.
tool.addDrawingHint: Put an image or PDF of a plan under the editor to trace it
tool.calibrateHint: Set the drawing's scale: click two points and type the real distance
hint.select: Click to select · drag points, walls, openings and names to move them · drag empty space to pan · scroll to zoom · Delete removes
hint.wall: Click to start a wall · it snaps to points, walls, straight angles and lines through other points · Alt turns snapping off
hint.wallNext: Click the next corner, or type a length (3.2 = metres, 320 = cm) · double-click, Enter or right-click to stop
hint.rect: Drag (or click two corners) to draw four walls around a room
hint.opening: Click a wall to put it there · for doors, click on the side it should open towards
hint.room: Click inside a closed room to name it
hint.calibrate: Click the start of something you know the length of (a dimension line, a wall)
hint.moveUnderlay: Drag the drawing to line it up with the walls
hint.calibrateFirst: Drawing added. Set its scale first: click two points a known distance apart, then type that distance.
hint.calibrated: Scale set. Now trace the walls with Wall or Room box.
